description: This file defines a UI component for displaying and interacting with session data, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and editing session properties in a web application.

methods.name: normalizeProviderId
methods.description: Normalizes provider ID strings, converting specific variants to a standard form.

methods.name: isBinaryThinkingProvider
methods.description: Determines if a provider uses binary thinking levels based on its ID.

methods.name: resolveThinkLevelOptions
methods.description: Returns appropriate think level options based on provider type.

methods.name: withCurrentOption
methods.description: Ensures current selection is included in options list.

methods.name: withCurrentLabeledOption
methods.description: Ensures current labeled option is included in options list.

methods.name: resolveThinkLevelDisplay
methods.description: Resolves display string for thinking level based on provider type.

methods.name: resolveThinkLevelPatchValue
methods.description: Converts thinking level value for patch updates based on provider type.

methods.name: filterRows
methods.description: Filters session rows based on search query.

methods.name: sortRows
methods.description: Sorts session rows based on specified column and direction.

methods.name: paginateRows
methods.description: Paginates session rows based on page number and size.

methods.name: renderSessions
methods.description: Main function to render the sessions UI component with filtering, sorting, pagination, and editing capabilities.

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders a single session row with interactive controls.
